about: Strayed gear in the supply crate. Each item is a People Playground item (ppgBase) wearing a sprite baked on the player's PC from their own Strayed install; no Strayed art ships with the mod.

columns.id: stable id used by the other sheets; also the baked sprite file name strayed/<id>.png
columns.displayName: name in the People Playground catalog
columns.strayedMesh: Mesh name inside Strayed_Data, or name#pathId when Strayed reuses the name (list with src/StrayedIndexTool)
columns.strayedTexture: Texture2D name (or name#pathId when reused) that the item prefab's material uses
columns.strayedDamage: damage in Strayed (strayed.wiki.gg/wiki/Tools player damage chart); 0 = not a weapon in the chart; shown in the item description
columns.ppgBase: People Playground item it is built on (behaviour, physics, sound); must exist in the game's catalog
columns.lengthM: real length in metres; the baker draws it at 50 px/m (People Playground's Baseball Bat is 42 px)
columns.lightRange: light radius in metres, 0 when not a light
columns.verified: true once mesh + texture were traced to the item's prefab in a real Strayed install
